landing.heroTitle: Help children want to complete routines without turning every day into a fight
landing.heroSubtitle: NidoQuest turns real responsibilities into missions, stars, and healthy rewards so families build habits with clarity, motivation, and follow-up.

outcomes.argumentsText: The task stops being a repeated scolding and becomes a visible agreement.
outcomes.routineText: Each explorer knows what to do, what it is worth, and how they are progressing.
outcomes.screensText: You choose healthy rewards: family time, plans, permissions, or experiences.

landing.problemText: Repeating the same tasks every day can be exhausting: studying, organizing rooms, limiting screens, routines, and good habits.
landing.solutionText: With NidoQuest, each responsibility becomes a clear, measurable, and motivating mission.
landing.howHeadline: In a few minutes you have a family system ready for explorers, missions, and rewards.
landing.benefitsHeadline: Built to sell calm: structure for parents and motivation for children.
landing.trustTitle: It is not another task app. It is a system to bring calm back home.
landing.trustQuote: When a child sees missions and stars, the conversation changes: it is no longer just obeying, it is moving forward.
landing.priceText: A simple price to organize habits, rewards, and family follow-up all year long.
landing.faqHeadline: Clear answers before creating your Nest

faq.customRewardsQ: Can I create my own rewards?
faq.customRewardsA: Yes. You define family rewards, permissions, experiences, or healthy benefits.
faq.mobileA: Yes. It is an installable PWA.
faq.languagesA: Yes. Latin American Spanish, English, and French.
